title: Counit compatibility of the lifted source-isomorphism unit comparison
statement: Let P,U,S be quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes, f:P\to S and f':U\to S quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and e:U\cong P with e_{hom}f=f'. Work in C_Z=D_{QCoh}(O_Z) [def-pc-derived-category], with the restricted derived pullbacks L_h and direct images R_h [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image, lem-sc-duality-base-change-inverse-square-mate]. Let a:C_S\to C_P and b:C_S\to C_U be supplied right adjoints of R_f and R_{f'}, with adjunctions adja and adjb. Supply an ambient natural isomorphism phi:a followed by inclusion and L_e\cong b followed by inclusion, satisfying SchemeIsoRightAdjointNormalized for these adjunctions [lem-sc-scheme-iso-right-adjoint-normalized]. Let A_h be the pinned ordinary pullback/direct-image adjunctions, c(e,f) the canonical pullback-composition comparison followed by the transport along e_{hom}f=f', and delta:R_{f'}\cong R_eR_f its right-adjoint conjugate [def-pc-derived-base-change-map, lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Supply a natural transformation k:R_f\to L_eR_{f'} whose ambient component after any two postcompositions t,v is R_f(eta_{e,E}) delta^{-1}(L_eE) t v. Then for every K in C_S, the ambient hom of k at a(K), followed by R_{f'}(phi_K) and the counit of adjb at K, equals the counit of adja at K. This involves one vertical morphism only, no base-change square and no second mate.

source.place: Tag 0ATR, counit compatibility for adjunction comparison under an equivalence

proof.text: Apply the supplied component identity at a(K), with the two postcompositions Rf′(phi_K) and the supplied adjb counit. The right-hand side is precisely SchemeIsoRightAdjointNormalized at K. Transitivity gives the stated ambient counit identity. Identity isomorphisms, zero objects, and empty schemes need no separate cases.

proof_origin.note: A normalization bridge for one vertical morphism, isolated from the ordinary square and from the categorical mate calculation.

theorem schemeIso_liftedComparison_counit
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {P U S : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace P] [QuasiSeparatedSpace P] [CompactSpace U] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U]
    [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S]
    (f : P ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (f' : U ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f'] [QuasiSeparated f']
    (e : U ≅ P) (he : e.hom ≫ f = f')
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory S ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory P)
    (b : schemeDerivedQCohCategory S ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory U)
    (adja : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty S).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty P).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _ f _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a)
    (adjb : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty S).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty U).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f')
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f') _ _ _ _ f' _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ b)
    (φ : (a ⋙ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty P).ι) ⋙ derivedPullback e.hom ≅
      b ⋙ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty U).ι) :
    let adj := fun {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (k : X ⟶ Y) ↦
      Classical.choose (exists_schemeDerivedAdjunction k
        (hAdd := (Classical.choose exists_derivedPullbackComposition) k)
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)) k)
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
          (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))) k))
    let comp := @Classical.choose _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))
    let c := comp e.hom f ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun k ↦ derivedPullback k) he)
    let δ := conjugateIsoEquiv (adj f')
      ((adj f).comp (adj e.hom)) c
    ∀ (k : qcDirectImage f ⟶ qcPullback e.hom ⋙ qcDirectImage f'),
      (∀ (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory P) (A B : schemeDerivedCategory S)
          (t : ((qcPullback e.hom ⋙ qcDirectImage f').obj E).obj ⟶ A) (v : A ⟶ B),
        (k.app E).hom ≫ t ≫ v =
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).map ((adj e.hom).unit.app E.obj) ≫
            δ.inv.app ((derivedPullback e.hom).obj E.obj) ≫ t ≫ v) →
      SchemeIsoRightAdjointNormalized f f' e he a b adja adjb φ →
      ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory S,
        (k.app (a.obj K)).hom ≫ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map (φ.hom.app K) ≫
          (adjb.counit.app K).hom = (adja.counit.app K).hom
